g.text: The four layers of an AI product
one question per layer: each is a separate choice, with its own risks and its own contract
where do I talk to it?
a loop where the model asks, tools act
your machine, or a vendor's cloud:
it sets what the agent can touch
or tool vendor: who sells and
A chatbot is layers 1 and 4: it answers, with no action loop and at most a sandbox of its own
